kind: actual HTTP requests against Node server and file-backed SQLite

checks.name: Signup stores scrypt hash, issues HttpOnly session, normalizes duplicate email
Login validates password and rotates the existing session
Creating a team creates its owner membership atomically
Invitation joins once and preserves role priority in relational tables
Only owner can mutate team and payload cannot change ownership
Profile public, team-only and private visibility are enforced server-side
Invalid URLs and excessive roles fail without partially saving data
Foreign origin cannot write using an existing session
SQLite profile, team and login session survive an actual server process restart
Deleting a team cascades memberships and member roles
Logout revokes server session even when previous cookie is replayed
